objects.name: Detection technique coverage: allow-inbound-traffic-in-firewall-rule
objects.description: The following analytic detects a suspicious PowerShell command that allows inbound traffic to a specific local port within the public profile. It leverages PowerShell script block logging (EventCode 4104) to identify commands containing keywords like "firewall," "Inbound," "Allow," and "-LocalPort." This activity is significant because it may indicate an attacker attempting to establish remote access by modifying firewall rules.
